fusions.name: Barbed Gnash
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that snags the target, dealing 4 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail-Line Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line of knotted rat tails at one enemy, dealing 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and holding it stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Reeled to the Warren
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. For 4 seconds, an escort of rats fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Something on the Line
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
